🔗 Google Sheets Auto-Sync
ເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ Google Sheets — ທຸກຄົນເຫັນຂໍ້ມູນດຽວກັນ Real-time
Live
📋 ວິທີຕັ້ງຄ່າ Apps Script (ໃຊ້ຄັ້ງດຽວ):
1. ໃນ Google Sheets → Extensions → Apps Script
2. ລຶບ code ເກົ່າ → Paste code ດ້ານລຸ່ມ → Save (💾)
3. Deploy → New deployment → Web app
4. Execute as: Me | Who has access: Anyone → Deploy
5. Copy Web app URL → Paste ຂ້າງເທິງ
function doGet() { var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet(); var sh = ss.getSheetByName("Break revenue") || ss.getSheets()[0]; var data = sh.getDataRange().getValues(); var headers = data[0]; var rows = []; for (var i = 1; i < data.length; i++) { if (!data[i][0] && !data[i][2]) continue; var row = {}; for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) { row[headers[j]] = data[i][j]; } rows.push(row); } var out = ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(rows)); out.setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON); return out; }
⚠ ໝາຍເຫດ: Publish URL ອາດຈະ CORS blocked ເມື່ອ host ໃນ Netlify — ໃຊ້ Apps Script ແທນດີກວ່າ
